description: Call this to get instructions for fixing one issue (an issue_id from get_audit or check_page): the kind of change, which files to look in, the exact target values and limits, and why. Apply it in the user's own repository: search for the current value before you edit, and follow the constraints. It returns instructions, not a diff. If the user would rather have Zevian make the change, use open_fix_pr.
name: get_fix
title: Get the fix for an issue
